description: This file defines the implementation of the RedirectInfo class and related functions for handling HTTP redirect logic, including method adjustment, referrer policy processing, and redirect URL computation within the net namespace.

classes.name: RedirectInfo
classes.description: Class encapsulating information about an HTTP redirect, including URL, method, referrer policy, and other redirect-related data.

methods.name: ComputeMethodForRedirect
methods.description: Determines the HTTP method to use after a redirect based on the original method and status code.

methods.name: ProcessReferrerPolicyHeaderOnRedirect
methods.description: Parses and applies the referrer policy header during a redirect, returning the appropriate referrer policy.

methods.name: RedirectInfo::ComputeRedirectInfo
methods.description: Static method that computes and returns a RedirectInfo object based on input parameters such as original URL, method, referrer, status code, and headers.
